archetype: Archetype 2: Performance Pro (Tactical Minimalism) blended with Brutalist Industrial
design_philosophy: A robust, mechanical, and high-trust dark interface representing an auto parts store. Employs stark contrasts (Deep Obsidian vs Pure White) and structural grid layouts. The rigid industrial feel is deliberately broken by a colorful, chaotic 'Post-it Note' review wall, fulfilling the 'Fusion over Imitation' E1 principle.

spacing_and_layout.surface_strategy: Flat solid surfaces with sharp 0px border-radius. 1px solid #27272A borders for separation. No soft shadows on industrial elements.

buttons.primary: bg-[#FF3B30] text-white font-bold uppercase tracking-widest px-8 py-4 rounded-none hover:bg-[#DC2626] transition-colors border-2 border-[#FF3B30]
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent text-white font-bold uppercase tracking-widest px-8 py-4 rounded-none border-2 border-white hover:bg-white hover:text-black transition-colors

inputs.default: bg-transparent border-b-2 border-[#52525B] text-white px-0 py-3 rounded-none focus:outline-none focus:border-[#FF3B30] focus:ring-0 transition-colors placeholder:text-[#52525B] font-mono text-lg

status_badge.container: inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1 bg-[#1F1F1F] border border-[#27272A]

post_it_note.container: relative p-6 shadow-lg aspect-square flex flex-col justify-between transition-transform hover:scale-105 hover:z-10 cursor-pointer

hero_section.background: Hero image of mechanic/engine with heavy black gradient overlay (bg-gradient-to-t from-[#0A0A0A] via-[#0A0A0A]/80 to-transparent)

inquiry_form.layout: Grid cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-12 items-start py-20
fields: VIN / Serie Șasiu (Text Input, uppercase formatting)

review_wall.title: H2: 'Ce spun clienții' (Stark white, left aligned)
review_wall.grid: Grid of colorful post-it notes (masonry or flex-wrap style). Each note uses random colors (yellow, pink, cyan) and slight rotations to look physically stuck to the screen.

admin_dashboard.layout: Control Room Grid (Dense, 1px borders, max utility)

inquiries_list.style: Cardless list, tabular data layout, monospace fonts for VINs
actions: Send Review Request link via SMS/WhatsApp

animations.post_it_hover: transition-transform duration-200 ease-out hover:scale-110 hover:-translate-y-2 hover:shadow-2xl z-10

image_urls.description: Close-up of mechanic repairing engine. Darken heavily with CSS overlay.
Mechanic smiling, lending a human, trustworthy touch to the industrial design.
Alternative darker mechanical parts for section backgrounds.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard Tailwind CSS classes mapping to the variables above.
Do NOT use generic borders for form inputs; use only bottom borders (border-b-2) to mimic technical forms.
For the post-it wall, use a CSS grid with specific rotation utilities (`-rotate-3`, `rotate-2`) appended randomly or systematically to elements.
Load 'Barlow Condensed' for headings and 'Caveat' for post-it notes from Google Fonts.
Implement the UI primarily for Mobile Web viewports, ensuring large touch targets.
Use Romanian phrasing in UI: 'În magazin', 'Pauză', 'Plecat' for status.
Do NOT use placeholder images. Use the URLs provided in `image_urls`.
